nodes.name: Daily Schedule 9:30AM IST
nodes.notes: 9:30 AM IST = 04:00 UTC every day. Mac launchd already published at 9:00 AM.

nodes.name: Fetch Today Briefing
nodes.notes: Calls /api/briefings/today. Uses BRIEFING_CRON_SECRET env var. Returns skip:true if no briefing.

nodes.name: Briefing Exists?
nodes.notes: TRUE (skip=false) → send emails. FALSE (skip=true) → stop cleanly.

nodes.name: No Briefing Today
nodes.notes: No briefing published today. Stop cleanly.

nodes.name: Get Subscribers
nodes.notes: Reads all rows from subscriber sheet. Credential: Google Sheets OAuth2.

nodes.name: Filter Active Subscribers
nodes.notes: Filters active subscribers and merges briefing data into each item for Gmail node.

nodes.name: Loop Subscribers
nodes.notes: Send one email per subscriber. n8n loops back automatically.
